body:
Thanks for the report! It seems like it may be a duplicate of one or both of these issues:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/86970
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/99018

It looks like, because of how inherited scenes are instantiated, the nodes in the scene are referencing an instance that is disposed. The base scene (`BaseNode.tscn`) is instantiated first which creates an instance of the `BaseNode.cs` script. Then, the derived scene (`InheritedNode.tscn`) is instantiated which creates an instance of the `InheritedNode.cs` script to replace  the old one. However, the nodes in the scene are still referencing the `BaseNode` object that is now disposed.

Your MRP is a little more convoluted because you have the `ToRootNode` instance in the middle, but I believe it's the same issue. So I'll be closing this issue as a duplicate.
